subject: Genetics
title: Diabetes Genetics
description: A micro-lesson that makes Diabetes Genetics usable.

hook.text: Type 2 diabetes runs in families—but no single gene explains it. Over 400 variants contribute tiny risk fragments.

buildup.text: Genes affect insulin, fat storage, appetite, and glucose processing. Each pathway has multiple risk variants.

discovery.text: If one identical twin gets type 2 diabetes, the other has a 70% chance. Genetic, but not simple.

twist.text: Diet and exercise can override genetic risk. High-risk genotypes stay healthy with lifestyle changes.

climax.text: Diabetes shows complex diseases are both polygenic and environmental. Neither nature nor nurture alone.

punchline.text: 400 genetic nudges. Lifestyle still tips the scale.

quiz.question: How many gene variants contribute to type 2 diabetes risk?
